scope: FIT plus validation development only; no outer prediction, metric, model choice or new adapter training

representation.R3: exact channel-attention input after patient-relative normalization, captured by forward pre-hook
representation.R4: exact original classifier input, captured by forward pre-hook

oracle.direction: unit-normalize each coefficient, then unit-normalize mean

summaries.COV: mean+population std+upper covariance triangle including diagonal,52D

predictors.D1: shared FIT logistic, equal patient mass and EZ/NEZ 0.5 each
predictors.D3: FIT-standardized multi-output Ridge(alpha=10,fit_intercept=True) to full unit oracle
predictors.D4: FIT-standardized Ridge(alpha=10,fit_intercept=True) to rank4 FIT coefficients

wrong_context: cyclic other-validation-patient context for D3/D4; target R4 unchanged; never used for selection
association: FIT-only pairwise Euclidean context distance versus oracle-direction cosine; Spearman rho, bootstrap CI; aggregate only
outer_policy: No outer loader, predictions, metrics or result inspection. Legacy monolithic cache label materialization must be disclosed if unavoidable.
public_outputs: aggregate-only code, lock, CSV, JSON and report; patient records/representations/labels/checkpoints/cache/logs remain private
